repair_priority_rule: If a lane's latest persisted audit is FIX_BEFORE_INTEGRATION or REJECT, repairing those findings takes priority over any scheduled feature work. A repaired candidate requires a fresh independent audit before integration.
objective: Repair all three negatively audited lanes against exact audit blockers (fresh independent audits required), while the accepted Integration lane hardens its orchestrator and delivers the token-verified HTTP services layer and webhook ingestion pipeline (Blueprint §4 flows 2/4).
canonical_contracts_notice: src/domain/ports.ts, src/shared/types.ts, src/shared/errors.ts are accepted canonical contracts (frozen by cycle-1 platform tests). Semantic changes belong to the Rules lane / Director contract amendment and require a fresh VERDICT: ACCEPT before integration. Repair lanes must consume these shapes, not fork them.

integration.task: Platform services layer v1, credential-free, inside src/platform/** (+ tests/platform/**): (a) Orchestrator hardening per accepted-audit observation N1: completeApply and failApply must reject EVERY terminal journal state (APPLY_COMPLETED, ROLLED_BACK, RECOVERED, failed-terminal) with INVALID_STATE PlatformError instead of only APPLY_COMPLETED; add regression tests proving a post-rollback or post-recovery completeApply call fails fast without appending a second audit entry. (b) Token-verified HTTP endpoint handler layer as pure, Wix-import-free modules under src/platform/http/** (thin src/pages/api/* adapters deferred to scaffold; document the wiring protocol in a README header like the cycle-1 contracts staging): GET active RuleSet; PUT RuleSet performing domain-side validation seam + revision-checked saveRuleSet via RulesConfigStore; POST apply-plan accepting ONLY a confirmed-diff hash reference; GET mutation status; POST recover for crash-mid-apply recovery. Every handler verifies the caller through an injected TokenVerifier port (adapter seam for @wix/essentials auth.getTokenInfo per Contract §6 - HTTP endpoints have NO built-in permissions model) and fails CLOSED with a typed shared-errors code on missing/invalid/expired tokens; request/response DTOs come from src/shared/types and errors from src/shared/errors; no business-rule logic. (c) Webhook ingestion pipeline under src/platform/webhooks/**: envelope-id dedup store port, entityEventSequence ordering buffer, idempotent at-least-once dispatch to registered handlers, and deterministic chaos tests proving duplicate deliveries, out-of-order sequences, and replays after simulated crashes converge exactly once; signature verification is an injected port (no fabricated crypto claims); document the Contract §6 constraints (1250 ms deadline, <=12 retries, duplicates expected) in module docs.
integration.why_needed: Blueprint §4 binding flows 2 (configuration via token-verified HTTP endpoints) and 4 (webhook counters with dedup/ordering/idempotency) have no platform implementation yet; Contract §6 makes explicit caller-token verification mandatory for every HTTP endpoint; accepted-audit observation N1 is a concrete hardening finding on integrated code. All three items are owned by this lane, need no credentials, and do not overlap any repair lane.

rules.task: MANDATORY REPAIR BRIEF - fix every blocking finding of reports/audits/CYCLE_32692407760_RULES.md before any new feature work, then submit the repaired candidate to a fresh independent audit. Blockers: (B1) src/domain/time/wallClock.ts imports isValidWindowStartMinute from './intlZone'; it is exported from '../model/primitives' - fix the specifier (TS2305 + cascading TypeError today). (B2) tests/domain/evaluate.test.ts and tests/domain/ruleset.validate.test.ts use depth-3 import specifiers that resolve above the repo root; change to '../../src/domain' and './helpers/*'. (B3) Five red assertions are provably wrong TESTS - fix fixtures/expectations WITHOUT changing correct implementation behavior: (1)(2) duplicates.test.ts confuses local wall time with UTC so the two identity-key tests never overlap - make instants genuinely overlap (e.g. existing booking 17:00Z-18:00Z vs proposal factsAt(WED,810,870)=17:30Z-18:30Z) keeping negative controls meaningful; (3) localDate.test.ts expects EST after US DST began 2026-03-08 - correct answer 22:30 Mar 8 local (1350), EDT; (4) wallClock.test.ts spring-forward 02:30 must advance to next valid local time 03:00 EDT (07:00Z), not 03:30; (5) Lord_Howe 02:05 on 2026-10-04 must advance to 02:30 LHDT (2026-10-03T15:30Z), not 02:35. Then ADD a genuinely-overlapping identity-key conflict test so IDENTITY_TIME_CONFLICT is asserted end-to-end (acceptance criterion 5 is currently unproven). (B4) IMPLEMENTATION DEFECT: slots ending exactly at local midnight are falsely blocked as overnight_slot even when a configured window ends at minute 1440 - treat an end instant landing on next-day 00:00 as endMinute=1440 for window fitting (only when endDate!==targetDate && minutesOfDay===0), keep genuine overnight spans blocked, and add regressions: 23:30-24:00 under [0,1440) ALLOWs; 23:30-00:30 BLOCKs as overnight. Non-blocking, fix in the same repair when safe: remove the literal '@wix/*' prose tripwire from src/domain/README.md wording; document the cross-midnight duplicate-protection v1 limitation; import RESERVED_RULE_IDS constants instead of hardcoding; strengthen duplicates negative controls so only the intended discriminator differs. Constraints: src/domain/ports.ts is an accepted canonical contract - preserve byte-identical unless a contract amendment is approved; repaired code must typecheck against accepted src/shared/types.ts shapes; self-verify via a scratch Vitest/tsc harness BEFORE submission (the cycle-1 candidate was submitted red, which the audit flagged as process failure A5).
